texto: The first thing I tried was the bathroom and I was blown away — the toilet and grout came out like new, without that harsh bleach smell. I barely buy cleaning products anymore.
The washer had a horrible smell and the step from The Repairman's Secret got it spotless. I saved myself the service call — the tech charged a fortune just to show up.
The kitchen and sink shine with almost nothing. What I like most is that now I know the exact amount; I used to eyeball it and it never worked.
I bought it half-doubting and ended up using it even in the garden. The plants look healthier and it killed off a fungus that wouldn't quit. Dirt cheap.
My daughter printed it out for me and I keep it in the kitchen like a manual. It's all organized room by room with the right measurements. At my age I appreciate that it's easy to follow.
I cleaned the AC following the guide and it cools like it used to. I thought I was going to have to replace it. With the combo I've already handled half the house.
